description: Search ImageKit documentation using semantic search.

query.description: Natural language search query about ImageKit features, APIs, SDKs, etc.

sources.description:
Optional list of documentation sources to search within.
     If not provided, sources are auto-detected from the query.

name: search_docs

description: Build an ImageKit image/video transformation URL from a natural language description.

fetch_url_to_check.description: Whether to verify the generated URL is accessible via CDN.

query.description:
Natural language description of the desired transformation
   (e.g. "resize to 800x600", "add blur and grayscale", "remove background").

src.description: Optional source image URL. If not provided, a default sample image is used.

name: transformation_builder
